expect.header: Decor ideas built arounddd sweets and color
expect.bodytext:
• Use one novelty centerpiece rather than many competing objects.
  • Pair candy tones with a single neutral background.
  • Keep copy short if the image is already lively.
  • Mix humor with just enough polish to stay usable.

expect.header: Playful objects make Easter easier to share
expect.bodytext: Chocolate bunnies, bright sweets, and simple decorative figures make Easter instantly readable. They lower the barrier to entry for casual seasonal content because people recognize the mood immediately. A playful object can carry the whole post when the goal is to feel festive, cheerful, and easy to enjoy.
